official: 神奈川県保育士試験手数料等に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 審議結果

name: 地域限定保育士試験の手数料を定める
summary: 県の条例では、国家戦略特別区域限定保育士試験の手数料などを定めています。この議案で試験の名称を地域限定保育士試験に改め、同試験の手数料を12,700円、全部免除申請の審査手数料を2,400円と定めます。試験を実施する機関に応じた手数料の納付先も定め、公布の日から施行します。
changes: 地域限定保育士試験の手数料を12,700円と定める
保育士試験と地域限定保育士試験の全部免除申請の審査手数料をそれぞれ2,400円と定める
試験を実施する機関に応じて手数料の納付先を定める
who: 地域限定保育士試験を受ける人
保育士試験または地域限定保育士試験の全部免除を申請する人
why: 児童福祉法等の改正で地域限定保育士制度が創設されたことに伴う改正のためと、県は説明しています。

en.name: Sets fees for the region-limited childcare worker exam
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Kanagawa Prefecture Ordinance on Fees for Childcare Worker Examinations, etc.
en.summary: The prefecture's ordinance sets fees for the National Strategic Special Zone-limited childcare worker exam, among other things. This bill changes the exam's name to the region-limited childcare worker exam and sets its fee at ¥12,700 and the review fee for an application for a full exemption at ¥2,400. It also specifies where fees must be paid, depending on the organization conducting the exam. It takes effect on the day it is promulgated.
changes: Sets the fee for the region-limited childcare worker exam at ¥12,700
Sets the review fee for applications for a full exemption from the childcare worker exam and the region-limited childcare worker exam at ¥2,400 for each exam
Specifies where fees must be paid, depending on the organization conducting the exam
who: People taking the region-limited childcare worker exam
People applying for a full exemption from the childcare worker exam or the region-limited childcare worker exam
en.why: The prefecture says this amendment is being made in response to the establishment of the region-limited childcare worker system through revisions to the Child Welfare Act and other laws.
